name: Hai Phong food guide
summary: Start with bánh đa cua: red crackers from Dư Hàng Kênh and crab. Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng, on 24 July 2023, puts a full bowl at lunch and says it is sold all day. Liên hiệp các tổ chức hữu nghị thành phố Hải Phòng, on 8 August 2021, calls it the common breakfast and the common evening meal. Bún cá cay, bánh mì cay, and trà cúc are the morning round. Where a price or an hour was not printed, it is Check on arrival.
body: The crackers are from Dư Hàng Kênh. The 2021 account calls them thin, soft, and chewy, and says the sign is often a small card tied to a tree. A full bowl on the 2023 map adds bề bề, chả lá lốt, shrimp, and fish cake in a crab broth. The crab is đồng or bể. Pavement tables on Trần Phú opposite the opera, from about 18:00 until past midnight, are the 2021 account. The 2023 map does not name Trần Phú. Whether that clock still holds is Check on arrival. A bánh đa price is Check on arrival.

Bánh mì cay is the small pate sandwich, with chí chương. Two prices stay: 2,500 đồng a piece on 24 July 2023, and 5,000–7,000 đồng on 23 December 2012. Trà cúc, on Phan Bội Châu, is printed at 20,000–25,000 đồng a glass on 24 July 2023. Sủi dìn is the winter dumpling. Bánh bèo is the square rice cake. Ốc is the evening plate. Đồ Sơn’s named plates are nộm sứa, tu hài nướng mỡ hành, and bề bề rang muối.

Chả rươi is printed three ways. The 16 October 2025 city account calls it a dish of the former Hải Dương land. TITC places the worm in Tiên Lãng and Vĩnh Bảo, in lunar months 9 and 10. Phường Hồng Bàng names Tứ Kỳ. Cua lông and bún cá rô đồng stay with the former Hải Dương sentence. They are not bún cá cay. Several names on the 2023 list, including bánh đúc tàu and cháo lòng, have no method in the account. Those methods are Check on arrival.
specialtiesLead: Bánh đa cua comes first. The other specialties follow, with the street when a publisher printed one.

sections.heading: Bowls
paragraphs: Bánh đa cua is the bowl with the crackers from Dư Hàng Kênh. Bún cá cay is the other morning bowl. Cháo lòng and bún tôm are named and not described.

spots.name: Bun ca cay
spots.note: Morning. Close to ten fish toppings, including offal and fish maw, plus banana blossom and dọc mùng, in a light broth with a chili note. Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng, 24 July 2023. A price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chao long
spots.note: Named on the 24 July 2023 specialty list. A method, a street, and a price were not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bun tom
spots.note: The city portal on 23 December 2012 says visitors ask for it, beside bánh đa cua, and does not describe the bowl. A method and a price are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: The small sandwich and the drinks
paragraphs: Bánh mì cay and trà cúc are the pair Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng puts after the morning bowl. Two bánh mì prices stay. Trà cúc has one printed range.

spots.name: Banh mi cay
spots.address: Lê Lợi, Minh Khai, and Phan Bội Châu
spots.note: Pate and chí chương, in a small crust. 2,500 đồng a piece on 24 July 2023. 5,000–7,000 đồng on 23 December 2012. The 2012 streets are Khánh Nạp on Hàng Kênh, Lê Lợi, and Đinh Tiên Hoàng. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Tra cuc
spots.note: Chrysanthemum, liquorice, and kumquat. Bitter, sweet, and astringent at once. 20,000–25,000 đồng a glass on 24 July 2023. Any time of day. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca phe cot dua
spots.note: Named as a city drink on 24 July 2023 and 16 October 2025. A method, a street, and a price were not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dua dam
spots.note: Named with the sweets at Cát Bi on 24 July 2023. Trường Chính trị Tô Hiệu names chè dừa dầm on 20 October 2026 and does not call it the same glass. A recipe is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Pate
spots.note: Named as its own city mark on 16 October 2025. The 2012 account puts it inside bánh mì cay and does not describe a separate plate. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Winter snacks and the markets
paragraphs: Sủi dìn and bánh bèo are described on 23 December 2012. Giá bể, bì bò, and chè are the afternoon market names on 24 July 2023. Bánh đúc tàu, nem chua, and chả chìa Hạ Lũng are named without a recipe.

spots.name: Sui din
spots.note: Winter. Shredded coconut, sesame, and peanuts in a ginger syrup. Wet-milled glutinous rice. Not chè and not bánh trôi. Any alley, on 23 December 2012. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh beo
spots.address: Lê Đại Hành, and the afternoon markets
spots.note: Square rice flour with pork, wood ear, and fried shallot, on banana leaf, dipped in fish sauce with chili powder and pepper. Lê Đại Hành on 23 December 2012. Cát Bi, Cố Đạo, Chu Văn An, and An Dương on 24 July 2023. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Gia be
spots.address: Chợ Cát Bi and the afternoon markets
spots.note: The 24 July 2023 list also writes giá bể xào. A method was not printed. Afternoon on that map. A price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bi bo
spots.address: Cát Bi, Cố Đạo, Chu Văn An, and An Dương
spots.note: Named with giá bể and bánh bèo for the afternoon on 24 July 2023. A method was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Che
spots.note: Các món chè, with the sweets, on 24 July 2023. A flavor was not printed. A price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh duc tau
spots.note: Named on the 24 July 2023 specialty list. What is in the cake was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Nem chua
spots.note: On the 24 July 2023 list, with no description. Nem chua An Thọ is a second name from Ban Tuyên giáo và Dân vận Thành ủy Hải Phòng, and the two are not called the same cake. A method is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cha chia Ha Lung
spots.note: Named with bánh đa cua on the 121-dish list of phase I of 2022, in the city portal’s 29 September 2023 account. A recipe was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Com chay hai san
spots.note: Named among traditional products by Ban Tuyên giáo và Dân vận Thành ủy Hải Phòng. No date and no method were printed. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Seafood plates
paragraphs: Nem cua bể is the square roll. Ốc is the evening plate in the center. Nộm sứa, tu hài, and bề bề rang muối are the Đồ Sơn plates from the 16 October 2025 speech. Chả rươi keeps every origin that was printed.

spots.name: Nem cua be
spots.note: Square and crisp, just out of the pan, on the Hồng Bàng account of 1 September 2025. Filling of crab, shrimp, pork, and wood ear, with rice noodles and sweet-sour fish sauce, on the account from Ban Tuyên giáo và Dân vận Thành ủy Hải Phòng. A street and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Oc
spots.note: Evening. Ốc hương, ốc đỏ môi, ốc móng tay, and ốc đá, as luộc mắm, sốt trứng muối, hấp Thái, or sốt me. Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng, 24 July 2023. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Nom sua
spots.note: A crisp jellyfish salad, in the Đồ Sơn speech printed on 16 October 2025. A lane, a price, and the hour are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Tu hai
spots.note: Geoduck grilled with scallion fat, in that same speech. A price and the hour are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Be be rang muoi
spots.note: Salt-fried mantis shrimp at Đồ Sơn on 16 October 2025. The 2023 map also puts bề bề in a bánh đa bowl. A price and the hour are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cha ruoi
spots.address: Lê Chân, Ngô Quyền, Lương Văn Can, and Cầu Đất on one account
spots.note: TITC: ragworm from Tiên Lãng and Vĩnh Bảo, lunar months 9 and 10, fried with pork, egg, dill, and tangerine peel, with sweet-sour fish sauce, herbs, and rice noodles. 16 October 2025: former Hải Dương, no recipe. 1 September 2025: rươi from Tứ Kỳ. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Regional dishes
paragraphs: Cua lông and bún cá rô đồng are the former Hải Dương names on 16 October 2025. Bánh cuốn and bánh đậu xanh are the Tây Hải Phòng names on 1 September 2025. Chả rươi is also in that former Hải Dương sentence, and it is described above because other accounts place it in Hai Phong.

spots.name: Cua long
spots.note: Named on 16 October 2025. Not the crab in bánh đa cua. A method, a port street, and a price were not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bun ca ro dong
spots.note: Named on 16 October 2025. Not bún cá cay. A method and a price were not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh cuon
spots.note: Named with bánh đậu xanh and chả rươi for a 2023 Tây Hải Phòng honor, on the Hồng Bàng account of 1 September 2025. The 29 September 2023 city account names a different pair for the 121-dish list. A recipe is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh dau xanh
spots.note: The same 1 September 2025 sentence. A recipe, a street, and a price were not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: These are the markets and streets the accounts name. A shop name is not a stop. An hour that was not printed, or that has not been printed again since 2021, is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cat Bi market
spots.address: phường Thành Tô, quận Hải An
spots.note: Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng, 24 July 2023, uses the middle of the market for bánh đa cua, giá bể, chè, dừa dầm, and bánh mì cay. An opening hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Afternoon markets
spots.nameVi: Chợ Cố Đạo, chợ Chu Văn An, chợ An Dương
spots.note: With Cát Bi, the afternoon round for giá bể, bì bò, and bánh bèo on 24 July 2023. Hours were not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Lach Tray
spots.note: The 24 July 2023 map places a bánh đa cua address and an ốc address on this street. A closing hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Tran Phu
spots.note: Liên hiệp các tổ chức hữu nghị thành phố Hải Phòng, on 8 August 2021, puts pavement tables here from about 18:00 until past midnight. The 2023 map does not name Trần Phú. Whether that clock still holds is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Phan Boi Chau
spots.note: Phố trà cúc on the 24 July 2023 map. Bánh mì cay is also named on Lê Lợi and Minh Khai. Hours were not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Le Dai Hanh
spots.address: The start of Lê Đại Hành
spots.note: The city portal on 23 December 2012 calls this stretch phố bánh bèo. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Do Son street food
spots.nameVi: Ẩm thực đường phố Đồ Sơn
spots.note: The 16 October 2025 training, at the Đồ Sơn ward office, names bánh đa cua, nộm sứa, tu hài, and bề bề. A single lane was not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng puts bún cá cay first in the morning, then bánh mì cay with trà cúc. The 8 August 2021 account calls bánh đa cua the common breakfast as well as the evening meal. The 23 December 2012 account also puts bánh mì cay at the end of the working day in winter. The clocks are Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Hai Phong food guide — bánh đa cua and the port snacks
seoDescription: Bánh đa cua, bún cá cay, bánh mì cay, and trà cúc, then the Đồ Sơn plates. Two bánh mì prices stay. An unprinted hour is Check on arrival.
